A.notes: Site A delivers a highly effective, console-inspired design that perfectly targets the backend engineer audience. The scroll-linked motion in the hero section brilliantly illustrates the core value proposition of filtering out log noise. Excellent craftsmanship and flawless accessibility checks complete a top-tier submission.

B.notes: Site B adopts a generic dark-mode SaaS aesthetic that feels disconnected from the CLI developer tool brief. It suffers from significant technical flaws, including nearly 200px of horizontal overflow on mobile and critical color contrast violations that trigger a hard gate failure. Motion is minimal and does little to tell the product's story.
